reasons.text: Estimated AI policy: four-bet to 26BB 95% for value; call 5% to retain SB's bluffs.
reasons.text_ja: AI推定方針：バリューで95%を26BBに4ベットし、5%はSBのブラフを残すためコール。

reasons.text: Four-bet 85% with premium strength and ace-king blockers; call 15% for suited playability in position.

reasons.text: Fold 85% because the large three-bet punishes the weak kicker; retain 10% calls and 5% ace-blocker four-bet bluffs.
